title: A Love Letter to Camp Mystic

sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最棒的球队。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，网址是 nytimes.com 斜杠 subscribe。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: By Monday evening, the death toll from the flooding in central Texas had surpassed 100.
sentences.zh: 到周一晚上，德克萨斯州中部的洪水造成的死亡人数已超过100人。

sentences.en: 27 of them from a single place.
sentences.zh: 其中27人来自同一个地方。

sentences.en: Camp Mystic, a century-old all-girls Christian summer camp.
sentences.zh: 神秘营，一个有百年历史的基督教全女子夏令营。

sentences.en: Today, the story of what that camp meant to the generations of girls who attended it.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要讲述这个营地对历届参加过的女孩们意味着什么的故事。

sentences.en: I spoke with one of them, Erin Pysan.
sentences.zh: 我采访了其中一位，艾琳·派森。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, July 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月8日，星期二。

sentences.en: Well, Erin, thank you for making time for us.
sentences.zh: 那么，艾琳，谢谢你抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: I, uh, it's been a hard three days for a lot of us in the Mystic community.
sentences.zh: 我，呃，对我们神秘营社区的许多人来说，这三天很难熬。

sentences.en: My first year at Mystic was 1975, when I was 10.
sentences.zh: 我第一次去神秘营是在1975年，那时我10岁。

sentences.en: And my mom sent me for five weeks.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈送我去了五周。

sentences.en: And how many years did you end up at Camp Mystic?
sentences.zh: 你最终在神秘营待了多少年？

sentences.en: Okay, so it was a bubble in, tumble in, look in, look out.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那是“泡进去、滚进去、看进去、看出来”。

sentences.en: Um, idiots.
sentences.zh: 嗯，白痴们。

sentences.en: Idiots.
sentences.zh: 白痴们。

sentences.en: That's the name of a cabin?
sentences.zh: 那是一个木屋的名字吗？

sentences.en: Idiots Delight was the name of it.
sentences.zh: 那是“白痴的快乐”木屋的名字。

sentences.en: I was there six summers.
sentences.zh: 我在那里度过了六个夏天。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I was not there as much as a lot of other people.
sentences.zh: 我待的时间没有其他人那么多。

sentences.en: But it was just a very special place for me, the years that I've spent there.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，我在那里度过的那些年是一个非常特别的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah, those are very formative years.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是塑造人格的岁月。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, Erin, that's what we want to talk to you about.
sentences.zh: 那么，艾琳，这就是我们想和你谈论的。

sentences.en: What Camp Mystic means to people, what it meant to campers like you, and why it occupied such a big place in the lives of so many people.
sentences.zh: 神秘营对人们意味着什么，对像你这样的营员意味着什么，以及为什么它在这么多人的生活中占据了如此重要的位置。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you could take us back to the very beginning of Camp Mystic for you.
sentences.zh: 我想请你带我们回到你最初接触神秘营的时候。

sentences.en: Talk about your first impressions of this place.
sentences.zh: 谈谈你对这个地方的第一印象。

sentences.en: Let me tell you about how I chose Camp Mystic.
sentences.zh: 让我告诉你我是怎么选择神秘营的。

sentences.en: My older brother went to Camp Stewart, which is on the other fork of the river.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥去了斯图尔特营，它在河流的另一条支流上。

sentences.en: And when we were down there picking him up, we went across a bridge that crosses the waterfront of Camp Mystic.
sentences.zh: 当我们去接他时，我们穿过了一座横跨神秘营水岸的桥。

sentences.en: And all these girls were out on the riverfront, splashing and playing, and it was just so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 所有的女孩都在河边嬉戏玩耍，那场景真是太美了。

sentences.en: And I was six years old, and I said to mom, I want to go to that camp.
sentences.zh: 那时我六岁，我对妈妈说，我想去那个营地。

sentences.en: And that's how I ended up at Camp Mystic.
sentences.zh: 这就是我最终去神秘营的原因。

sentences.en: I was not one of those kids who was on a generational liSt.
sentences.zh: 我不是那种在代际名单上的孩子。

sentences.en: Just explain that generational liSt.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下那个代际名单。

sentences.en: It was such a special place that generations of women wanted to send their daughters or granddaughters.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常特别的地方，几代女性都想把女儿或孙女送去那里。

sentences.en: And there was only a certain amount of space.
sentences.zh: 但名额是有限的。

sentences.en: So if you wanted your daughter or granddaughter to go, you had to get on the list early.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想让你的女儿或孙女去，你必须尽早排上名单。

sentences.en: And some people thought it was birth.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为是从出生就开始排。

sentences.en: Get on the list at birth.
sentences.zh: 出生时就排上名单。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And my mom was a single parent of four children.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈是一个带着四个孩子的单亲妈妈。

sentences.en: We were not, like, an elite family.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是那种精英家庭。

sentences.en: And somehow my mom, I don't know, I got off the list and went.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，我妈妈，我不知道，我排上了名单并去了那里。

sentences.en: Well, paint a picture of what this place is like for the younger version of you when you arrive.
sentences.zh: 那么，请为我们描绘一下，当你到达时，这个地方对年轻时的你来说是什么样的。

sentences.en: Clearly you had an idea of it from seeing it from the waterfront with your brother.
sentences.zh: 显然你从你哥哥那里通过水岸看到它时，就已经有了一个概念。

sentences.en: But when you actually get there.
sentences.zh: 但当你真正到达那里时呢？

sentences.en: So let it be known that I packed my trunk in December.
sentences.zh: 要知道，我在十二月就收拾好了行李箱。

sentences.en: I was so excited.
sentences.zh: 我太兴奋了。

sentences.en: December for a summer that was many, many, many, many months away.
sentences.zh: 在距离夏天还有好几个月的时候，我就在十二月收拾好了。

sentences.en: I was second term.
sentences.zh: 我是第二期去的。

sentences.en: I wasn't even first term.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不是第一期。

sentences.en: I went in early July.
sentences.zh: 我在七月初去的。

sentences.en: And when that day finally comes, you get on that bus with a lot of older girl campers that have gone for years.
sentences.zh: 当那一天终于到来时，你和许多已经去了多年的大女孩营员一起坐上那辆巴士。

sentences.en: And these are girls who are in high school.
sentences.zh: 那些都是上高中的女孩。

sentences.en: And you're like, oh, and you're heading down toward the hill country.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得，噢，你正前往丘陵地带。

sentences.en: And the best part is you're looking for the mystic sign.
sentences.zh: 最棒的部分是你一直在寻找那个神秘的标志。

sentences.en: There is a lighted sign that overlooks the river.
sentences.zh: 有一个发光的标志俯瞰着河流。

sentences.en: And so as soon as you start to see the mystic sign and turn that corner, everyone just starts screaming.
sentences.zh: 所以当你开始看到那个神秘标志并转过那个弯时，每个人都开始尖叫。

sentences.en: Because they are so excited to go through those gates.
sentences.zh: 因为她们太兴奋了，终于要穿过那些大门了。

sentences.en: And people get off of that bus and they go running for their friends from the summer before.
sentences.zh: 人们从巴士上下来，跑向她们去年夏天结识的朋友。

sentences.en: I'm just so struck by the excitement and the joy that you are conveying in this moment.
sentences.zh: 你此刻所传达出的兴奋和喜悦让我深受触动。

sentences.en: I mean, you are very far removed from this experience.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你已经离开这段经历很久了。

sentences.en: But you're right back there.
sentences.zh: 但你仿佛又回到了那里。

sentences.en: Well, listen, I am not lying.
sentences.zh: 听着，我没有撒谎。

sentences.en: And you could have my two daughters on this call who know that when I die, my ashes are to be spread at Camp Mystic.
sentences.zh: 你可以问问我的两个女儿，她们知道我死后，骨灰要撒在神秘营。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It runs that deep for people who went to that camp.
sentences.zh: 对于去过那个营地的人来说，这种感情非常深厚。

sentences.en: It was a very, very safe space.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常、非常安全的空间。

sentences.en: You know, it just was a clean slate.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那就像一张白纸。

sentences.en: No one knew what you were like at school every day.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道你在学校里是什么样的人。

sentences.en: No one knew that I was the geeky kid.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道我是那个书呆子孩子。

sentences.en: I just was a Camp Mystic girl.
sentences.zh: 我只是一个神秘营的女孩。

sentences.en: I didn't even have a present father.
sentences.zh: 我甚至没有一个在场的父亲。

sentences.en: I didn't know what anybody else's father did or how much money or the size of the house they lived in.
sentences.zh: 我不知道其他人的父亲是做什么的，也不知道他们有多少钱或住多大的房子。

sentences.en: It was a space where people could come and it was a level playing field.
sentences.zh: 那是一个人们可以来到这里，并且处于公平竞争环境的空间。

sentences.en: You're describing an experience of being anonymous in the best possible way because from what you're saying, you didn't have an idyllic childhood.
sentences.zh: 你描述的是一种以最好的方式隐姓埋名的体验，因为从你的话来看，你的童年并不理想。

sentences.en: I felt different from.
sentences.zh: 我感觉与众不同。

sentences.en: My mom was a busy mom.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈是一个忙碌的妈妈。

sentences.en: She was one of the only divorced parents when I went off to camp.
sentences.zh: 我去营地时，她是仅有的几个离婚家长之一。

sentences.en: So I did not have an idyllic childhood.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有一个田园诗般的童年。

sentences.en: I had a privileged childhood.
sentences.zh: 我有一个优越的童年。

sentences.en: But, you know, just because you're privileged doesn't mean that things are always going well at home.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，仅仅因为你优越并不意味着家里一切都好。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of kids were grappling with themselves and they came to Mystic.
sentences.zh: 我认为很多孩子都在与自己抗争，然后她们来到了神秘营。

sentences.en: And it was just a place to be a child.
sentences.zh: 那只是一个可以做孩子的地方。

sentences.en: What did it mean to be at a camp with only other girls?
sentences.zh: 在一个只有女孩的营地意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, I didn't have an older sister.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没有姐姐。

sentences.en: I had an older brother and he was great, but I looked up to girls.
sentences.zh: 我有一个哥哥，他很棒，但我很崇拜女孩。

sentences.en: I don't think I understood that at the time.
sentences.zh: 我想当时我并不明白这一点。

sentences.en: And it was also a place where you could just be silly.
sentences.zh: 而且那也是一个你可以尽情傻气的地方。

sentences.en: And I don't know that I would have been silly in front of boys at that age.
sentences.zh: 我不知道在那个年纪，我在男孩面前是否还能那么傻气。

sentences.en: There were all kinds of shenanigans always going on at Camp Mystic between these girls.
sentences.zh: 神秘营的女孩们之间总是有各种各样的恶作剧。

sentences.en: I mean, there were pranks.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有各种整蛊。

sentences.en: What's your favorite shenanigan?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢的恶作剧是什么？

sentences.en: I probably shouldn't mention this one.
sentences.zh: 我可能不该提这个。

sentences.en: But you would be standing in line waiting to get into the dining hall and someone would just come up and yank your pants down to your ankles.
sentences.zh: 但当你排队等候进入餐厅时，会有人突然走过来把你的裤子拉到脚踝。

sentences.en: I mean, it was those kinds of crazy, funny, we rolled around in the mud and we threw mud at each other and, you know, juSt...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就是那种疯狂、有趣的事情，我们在泥里打滚，互相扔泥巴，你知道，就是……

sentences.en: You were free to be exactly who you wanted to be in that moment.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，你可以自由地做你想做的自己。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: At a time, I guess we should say, when you're just figuring out who you are.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该说，那是在你刚刚开始了解自己是谁的时候。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And it was so easy because it was such a beautiful place.
sentences.zh: 而且这很容易，因为那是一个如此美丽的地方。

sentences.en: Well, just describe this beautiful place, the layout, the geography.
sentences.zh: 那么，请描述一下这个美丽的地方，它的布局、地理环境。

sentences.en: Once you're there, you're off that bus, what do you see and what do you feel?
sentences.zh: 一旦你到了那里，下了巴士，你看到了什么，感觉到了什么？

sentences.en: The road into Mystic is something I still dream about on a regular basis.
sentences.zh: 通往神秘营的路，我至今仍经常梦到。

sentences.en: You roll through the gate and on your left is a huge swath, which is called the golf course, but I think it's used for a lot of different things.
sentences.zh: 你穿过大门，左边是一大片草地，被称为高尔夫球场，但我认为它被用于很多不同的用途。

sentences.en: But it's a very open field with the background of the hills.
sentences.zh: 但那是一片非常开阔的场地，背景是群山。

sentences.en: It is a spectacular view.
sentences.zh: 那里的景色非常壮观。

sentences.en: And that's where the mystic sign at night is lit up and shines over the river.
sentences.zh: 晚上，神秘的标志在那里亮起，照耀着河流。

sentences.en: And then the waterfront, which was what initially drew me.
sentences.zh: 然后是水岸，那是我最初被吸引的原因。

sentences.en: We spent a lot of time having campfires down by the water and the smell.
sentences.zh: 我们在水边花了很多时间举行篝火晚会，还有那种气味。

sentences.en: Oh, you know...
sentences.zh: 噢，你知道……

sentences.en: What is the smell?
sentences.zh: 是什么气味？

sentences.en: The smell is the trees and the cedar and the river.
sentences.zh: 那是树木、雪松和河流的味道。

sentences.en: I wonder if you can spend a little more time on that river.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你能不能多花点时间谈谈那条河。

sentences.en: Clearly, it's what drew you into this place.
sentences.zh: 显然，正是它吸引你来到这个地方。

sentences.en: And what is it like and what role does it play in the life of the camp?
sentences.zh: 它是什么样的，在营地的生活中扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: The river is like a character.
sentences.zh: 这条河就像一个角色。

sentences.en: Because if you had an 8 o'clock swim class, you were dreading going in that river because it was frigging cold.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你有8点的游泳课，你会害怕下水，因为它冷得要命。

sentences.en: But it was also a place of refreshment.
sentences.zh: 但它也是一个让人焕然一新的地方。

sentences.en: They had these huge floats on the river that you could swim out to and jump off of.
sentences.zh: 河上有巨大的浮台，你可以游过去跳下来。

sentences.en: There was a diving board.
sentences.zh: 那里有跳水板。

sentences.en: There was snorkeling.
sentences.zh: 有浮潜。

sentences.en: There was canoeing.
sentences.zh: 有划独木舟。

sentences.en: And we spent a lot of time having campfires down by the water.
sentences.zh: 我们在水边花了很多时间举行篝火晚会。

sentences.en: There was a song called Peace, I Ask of the O'River.
sentences.zh: 有一首歌叫《和平，我祈求河流》。

sentences.en: And we sang it at bonfires.
sentences.zh: 我们在篝火旁唱这首歌。

sentences.en: And then there was the...
sentences.zh: 然后还有……

sentences.en: There's a camp on the Guadalupe River.
sentences.zh: 瓜达卢佩河上有一个营地。

sentences.en: It is the camp of my dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 那是我梦中的营地。

sentences.en: Where the whippoorwills call softly and the bright moonbeaMs.
sentences.zh: 那里的夜鹰轻声鸣叫，明亮的月光洒下。

sentences.en: There's a camp on the Guadalupe River.
sentences.zh: 瓜达卢佩河上有一个营地。

sentences.en: Where hearts are loyal and true.
sentences.zh: 那里的人们忠诚而真诚。

sentences.en: Camp Mystic, I will pledge my true and faithful love to you.
sentences.zh: 神秘营，我将向你许下我真诚而忠实的爱。

sentences.en: I sang that to my children in the middle of the night when they were babies.
sentences.zh: 孩子们还是婴儿的时候，我曾在深夜里唱给他们听。

sentences.en: What does it feel like to sing that song right now?
sentences.zh: 现在唱起这首歌，你是什么感觉？

sentences.en: It's just, it's heartbreaking.
sentences.zh: 就是，就是让人心碎。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Honestly, you know, I live with a man who, when he can't sleep, he plays a golf course in his mind.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我住在一起的那个人，他睡不着的时候，会在脑海里打一场高尔夫球。

sentences.en: I go straight to the river at Camp Mystic.
sentences.zh: 而我，会直接去神秘营的那条河边。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And it calms me because at night, the way that the bonfires, the campfires on the river happened, where everybody lined up by cabin.
sentences.zh: 那让我感到平静，因为在晚上，河边的篝火，大家按木屋排成一排的样子。

sentences.en: And oftentimes we were holding candles and you sang all the way to the river.
sentences.zh: 我们经常手持蜡烛，一路唱着歌走到河边。

sentences.en: And you brought a towel and you sat in the cool, wet grass.
sentences.zh: 你带着毛巾，坐在凉爽潮湿的草地上。

sentences.en: And the river was just like glass some nights.
sentences.zh: 有些夜晚，河面就像镜子一样平静。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Calm.
sentences.zh: 平静。

sentences.en: Calm.
sentences.zh: 平静。

sentences.en: So in the restless version of your night, when you see this river, you see the calm, idyllic version.
sentences.zh: 所以在你辗转反侧的夜晚，当你想到这条河时，你看到的是它平静、田园诗般的一面。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I just go to Camp Mystic in my mind.
sentences.zh: 我脑海里只会浮现出神秘营。

sentences.en: You know, I just picture being there and how I felt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只是想象自己身处那里，以及我当时的感觉。

sentences.en: Aaron, were you or anyone else in the camp ever instructed to think about this river, which is clearly the source of so much joy and activity?
sentences.zh: 艾琳，你或者营地里的其他人，有没有被教导过要留意这条河？它显然是你们欢乐和活动的主要源泉。

sentences.en: Were you ever told to see it as something that could be dangerous?
sentences.zh: 有没有人告诉过你要把它看作是有危险的东西？

sentences.en: Well, not from a flooding standpoint, but nobody ever went near the water without a counselor near them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不是从洪水泛滥的角度，但如果没有辅导员在身边，没人会靠近水边。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Now, I do, okay, here's one thing I do remember.
sentences.zh: 不过，我确实记得一件事。

sentences.en: The thing I was most afraid of was someone crossing the river in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 我最害怕的是半夜有人穿过那条河。

sentences.en: Because there were so many horror movies out, you know.
sentences.zh: 因为当时有很多恐怖电影，你懂的。

sentences.en: And, oh, an outsider somehow getting across the river to the campers.
sentences.zh: 还有，哦，担心有外人以某种方式穿过河流来到营员身边。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: The camp was very protective of campers, you know.
sentences.zh: 营地对营员非常保护，你知道的。

sentences.en: Their safety was numero uno.
sentences.zh: 他们的安全是头等大事。

sentences.en: And so they had a night watchman, and he sat in a waterfront chair with a shotgun every night.
sentences.zh: 所以他们每晚都会安排一名夜间守卫，坐在河边的椅子上，手里拿着猎枪。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I felt protected, you know.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很有安全感，你知道吗。

sentences.en: There was a lot of protocol around safety there.
sentences.zh: 那里有很多关于安全的规章制度。

sentences.en: But not around flooding?
sentences.zh: 但不是针对洪水？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: Not prior to 78.
sentences.zh: 78年之前没有。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnaloo.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才那几位一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: Erin, when did you come to understand that flooding was a potential danger at this camp?
sentences.zh: 艾琳，你是什么时候意识到洪水是这个营地潜在危险的？

sentences.en: I was 13.
sentences.zh: 那时我13岁。

sentences.en: And I don't really even remember it raining all that hard when we went to bed.
sentences.zh: 我们睡觉时，我甚至不记得雨下得有多大。

sentences.en: I was on the top bunk, and in the middle of the night, I mean, you could start to hear the rain really coming down.
sentences.zh: 我睡在上铺，半夜里，雨声大得惊人。

sentences.en: It woke me up, and I got up, and I looked out, and there was this huge cypress tree right next to the creek.
sentences.zh: 我被吵醒了，起身向外看，小溪边有一棵巨大的柏树。

sentences.en: At the top of this cypress tree, there was a light that lit the way up the hill, and the water was just below the light.
sentences.zh: 柏树顶上有一盏灯照亮了上山的路，水面已经涨到了灯的下方。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And I was terrified.
sentences.zh: 我当时吓坏了。

sentences.en: And I can't remember whether my counselor was already up and could see what was going on, but I walked over to her and I said, we've got to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 我不记得我的辅导员当时是否已经醒来并察觉到了情况，但我走到她身边说，我们必须离开这里。

sentences.en: You could tell that this was flooding.
sentences.zh: 你能看出来这就是洪水。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So we were all told that we were going to be moved up to a cabin called Angel's Attic.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都被告知要转移到一个叫“天使阁楼”的木屋。

sentences.en: So you were pretty much evacuated from your cabin?
sentences.zh: 所以你们基本上是从木屋撤离了？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We didn't have food for a couple of days.
sentences.zh: 我们有几天没有食物。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And what I do remember was cars going down the river, deer, animals, all kinds of big things that you're just like, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时有汽车被冲下河，还有鹿、动物，各种各样的大东西，你只会觉得，天哪。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And the golf course looked like the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.zh: 高尔夫球场看起来就像太平洋一样。

sentences.en: I just couldn't believe I was looking out on all this water that was just raging.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信我眼前看到的是一片汹涌的洪水。

sentences.en: And then what really resonated with me was how devoted the staff was to keeping everybody safe.
sentences.zh: 真正让我感触颇深的是，工作人员为了保护大家的安全是多么尽职尽责。

sentences.en: The water was starting to recede a little bit, but it was still raging.
sentences.zh: 水位开始稍微下降，但依然汹涌。

sentences.en: And I remember watching with horror as a counselor.
sentences.zh: 我记得我惊恐地看着一位辅导员。

sentences.en: They were trying to get food over to us, like peanut butter sandwiches or something from the dining hall.
sentences.zh: 他们试图把食物，比如花生酱三明治之类的东西，从餐厅送过来。

sentences.en: And they got on a horse.
sentences.zh: 他们骑上了一匹马。

sentences.en: And I remember watching them try to get across.
sentences.zh: 我记得看着他们试图穿过河道。

sentences.en: And I was like, please, God, please, please don't let anything happen to these people.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，求求上帝，求求你，千万别让这些人出事。

sentences.en: Like, everyone was just waiting, you know, just couldn't believe they were trying to get to us because it was still really dangerous.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在等待，你知道，简直不敢相信他们竟然试图穿过河来找我们，因为当时真的很危险。

sentences.en: But understand that the flood of 78 was nothing.
sentences.zh: 但你要明白，78年的洪水根本不算什么。

sentences.en: It just doesn't, that pales in comparison to what just happened.
sentences.zh: 那和刚刚发生的事情相比，简直是小巫见大巫。

sentences.en: Well, knowing what you know about flooding at this camp, when did you first hear that there had been another much, much worse flood?
sentences.zh: 既然你了解这个营地的洪水情况，你是什么时候第一次听说又发生了一场更严重得多的洪水？

sentences.en: Well, I'm constantly on the Camp Mystic Alumni Reunion site on social media.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我一直在社交媒体上关注神秘营校友重聚的页面。

sentences.en: So, I think I must have started to see things on that firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想我一定是先在那里看到的。

sentences.en: And people were just in a frenzy, just so grieved.
sentences.zh: 大家当时都陷入了疯狂，悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: Everybody's just heartbroken.
sentences.zh: 每个人都心碎了。

sentences.en: But honestly, until yesterday, I was completely numb.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，直到昨天，我整个人都是麻木的。

sentences.en: Yesterday, I just fell apart.
sentences.zh: 昨天，我彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: Yesterday was the day that I just broke.
sentences.zh: 昨天是我彻底垮掉的一天。

sentences.en: When I started seeing some of the pictures of these campers, one is two little girls that were best friends.
sentences.zh: 当我开始看到这些营员的照片时，其中有两个好朋友，两个小女孩。

sentences.en: Lila Bonner and her little friend, Eloise Peck, with their arms around each other, just broke me.
sentences.zh: 莱拉·邦纳和她的小伙伴埃洛伊丝·佩克，她们互相拥抱着，那一幕彻底击垮了我。

sentences.en: Just broke me.
sentences.zh: 彻底击垮了我。

sentences.en: And then the footage of the girls that were being evacuated.
sentences.zh: 还有那些女孩被撤离时的录像。

sentences.en: I know, I'm trying so hard not to cry.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我正努力不让自己哭出来。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about that footage?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我说说那段录像吗？

sentences.en: I haven't seen it.
sentences.zh: 我还没看过。

sentences.en: They're seeing the destruction.
sentences.zh: 她们看到了破坏的景象。

sentences.en: And they're singing through it.
sentences.zh: 但她们在歌声中度过了难关。

sentences.en: That's what we did at Mystic.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在神秘营所做的事。

sentences.en: You know, we just sang.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们只是唱歌。

sentences.en: So, really, in the middle of the worst thing that will likely ever happen to these girls, they are invoking the songs that you learned when you first got there,
sentences.zh: 所以，在这些女孩可能经历的最糟糕的事情中，她们唱起了刚到营地时学到的歌，

sentences.en: and that seems so essential to the culture of this place.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是这个地方文化中不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: They're taking care of each other.
sentences.zh: 她们在互相照顾。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's part of being what they call a mystic girl.
sentences.zh: 这就是成为她们所说的“神秘女孩”的一部分。

sentences.en: We look out for each other.
sentences.zh: 我们互相关照。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And we trust God.
sentences.zh: 我们信仰上帝。

sentences.en: You know, whoever that is for you, you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论对你来说那意味着什么，你懂的。

sentences.en: Can I ask you what may feel like a very delicate question, about these floods?
sentences.zh: 我可以问你一个关于这些洪水的问题吗？可能听起来有些敏感。

sentences.en: And perhaps it strikes you as too early to ask this, but your own experience makes me want to ask you it.
sentences.zh: 也许你觉得现在问这个问题还太早，但你自己的经历让我很想问你。

sentences.en: This wonderful place floods with some frequency, right?
sentences.zh: 这个美好的地方经常发生洪水，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, it happened to you in 78, but in my reading and in the reporting from our colleagues at the Times,
sentences.zh: 我是说，78年你经历过，但在我的阅读和我们《时报》同事的报道中，

sentences.en: it happened again with deadly consequences in, I think, 1987 in this region, and even more deadly consequences this past weekend, July 4th.
sentences.zh: 我想在1987年，这个地区又发生了一次造成致命后果的洪水，而就在上个周末，7月4日，后果甚至更加惨重。

sentences.en: How do you think about why, whether it's parents or local officials, the folks who run the camp, why people keep tolerating the risk level of these floods,
sentences.zh: 你认为为什么，无论是家长还是当地官员，或者是营地的经营者，为什么人们一直容忍这种洪水风险，

sentences.en: and perhaps not doing a ton to mitigate them?
sentences.zh: 却可能没有采取太多措施来减轻风险？

sentences.en: Like in 1978, that flood rose so fast in the middle of the night that you couldn't see.
sentences.zh: 就像1978年那次，洪水在半夜涨得太快，你根本看不见。

sentences.en: Nobody could see or predict it was going to rise that faSt.
sentences.zh: 没人能预见或预测到它会涨得那么快。

sentences.en: So what would have worked?
sentences.zh: 那么什么才有效呢？

sentences.en: A siren system in that area, to my knowledge, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 那个地区有警报系统吗？据我所知，我不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, it is so remote down there that trying to put a siren system in is not something I'm sure they looked at it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那里太偏远了，安装警报系统是不是他们考虑过的，我不确定。

sentences.en: They did.
sentences.zh: 他们考虑过。

sentences.en: In fact, the local officials talked about it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当地官员讨论过这个问题。

sentences.en: But I'm hearing you say you're not convinced that even if the best system was in place, it would necessarily prevent the worSt.
sentences.zh: 但我听你的意思是，即使有了最好的系统，也不一定能防止最坏的情况发生？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I think it's a difficult—it's a huge—it's a huge lift in that area because you can barely get cell service.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很难，这是一个巨大的工程，因为那里几乎没有手机信号。

sentences.en: And these camps are so spread out, you know?
sentences.zh: 而且这些营地分布得太广了，你知道吗？

sentences.en: But honestly, as someone who lived through a flood down there that came on the camp so fast that nobody could have stopped it, even a siren system, I mean, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，作为一个经历过那场洪水的人，洪水来得太快，没人能阻止它，即使有警报系统，我是说，我不知道。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, what do you think happens to Camp Mystic now?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为神秘营现在会怎么样？

sentences.en: The damage is really extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 破坏确实非常严重。

sentences.en: And there's the reality that folks may not want to send their children back to a place that has now flooded so catastrophically and could, in theory, flood catastrophically again.
sentences.zh: 而且现实情况是，人们可能不想再把孩子送到一个已经遭受如此灾难性洪水，且理论上可能再次发生灾难性洪水的地方。

sentences.en: Well, of course, I would love to see Camp Mystic come back, but I don't think—yeah, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，我很想看到神秘营重新开张，但我认为——是的，我不知道。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Maybe this was a wake-up call for the community that the money needs to be invested in something.
sentences.zh: 也许这对社区来说是一个警钟，资金需要投入到某些方面。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know what that answer is.
sentences.zh: 我不知道答案是什么。

sentences.en: All I can say is it was a very important place to me and many other young girls and women.
sentences.zh: 我只能说，它对我以及许多其他年轻女孩和女性来说是一个非常重要的地方。

sentences.en: Still is.
sentences.zh: 现在依然是。

sentences.en: I wonder if, after everything that's just happened, when you are sitting in bed, restless
sentences.zh: 我想知道，在经历了这一切之后，当你晚上躺在床上辗转反侧时，

sentences.en: at night, if you think you will still think back to the image of the river, this calm river, which is what you said you think about.
sentences.zh: 你是否还会回想起那条河的画面，那条你所说的平静的河流？

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I will never not go to that river.
sentences.zh: 我永远都会回到那条河边。

sentences.en: Has it become sort of a character in my mind that can be angry sometimes?
sentences.zh: 它在我心中是否已经变成了一个有时会发怒的角色？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But I choose to hold on to the beautiful moments there, where you could hear the, you know, the locusts and the crickets and the crackle of the, you know, the bonfire.
sentences.zh: 但我选择保留在那里度过的美好时光，在那里你可以听到蝉鸣、蟋蟀声，还有篝火的噼啪声。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: We understand.
sentences.zh: 我们理解。

sentences.en: And the voices of all these girls singing softly together, you know.
sentences.zh: 还有所有这些女孩轻声合唱的声音，你知道的。

sentences.en: We understand.
sentences.zh: 我们理解。

sentences.en: We understand.
sentences.zh: 我们理解。

sentences.en: I hang on to those things, and that's what makes it special.
sentences.zh: 我珍藏着这些东西，这正是它们的特别之处。

sentences.en: Change your mind.
sentences.zh: 改变你的想法吧。

sentences.en: Come back to Mystic.
sentences.zh: 回到神秘营来。

sentences.en: And you will find.
sentences.zh: 你会发现的。

sentences.en: Well, Erin, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，艾琳，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Truly, we appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真心感激。

sentences.en: And you're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: It's a privilege to share about this place.
sentences.zh: 能分享关于这个地方的一切是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: We love you, Mystic.
sentences.zh: 我们爱你，神秘营。

sentences.en: Hundreds of Camp Mystic alumni and supporters gathered at a park in Dallas for a vigil to mourn those who had died at the camp.
sentences.zh: 数百名神秘营的校友和支持者聚集在达拉斯的一个公园里，举行守夜活动，悼念那些在营地中遇难的人。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the lieutenant governor of Texas, Dan Patrick, expressed dismay that a system of flood-warning sirens were not in place to protect places like Camp Mystic, and said
sentences.zh: 与此同时，德克萨斯州副州长丹·帕特里克对未能建立洪水预警警报系统来保护像神秘营这样的地方表示失望，并表示

sentences.en: that the state's government would seek to have such a system installed by next summer.
sentences.zh: 州政府将争取在明年夏天之前安装此类系统。

sentences.en: Had we had sirens along this area, up and down, that would have blown very loudly.
sentences.zh: 如果我们在这片区域沿线安装了警报器，它们本会发出巨大的响声。

sentences.en: It's possible that that would have saved some of these lives.
sentences.zh: 这或许能挽救其中一些生命。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, President Trump revived his threat of tariffs, ranging from 25 percent to 40 percent, against countries that have yet to reach trade deals with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周一，特朗普总统重申了对尚未与美国达成贸易协议的国家征收25%至40%关税的威胁。

sentences.en: Among the countries threatened were Japan, South Korea, and South Africa.
sentences.zh: 受到威胁的国家包括日本、韩国和南非。

sentences.en: Trump paused his original tariffs for 90 days until July 9th, and has extended that deadline until August 1St.
sentences.zh: 特朗普此前将最初的关税措施推迟了90天，至7月9日，随后又将截止日期延长至8月1日。

sentences.en: The new threats appear designed to encourage deals before then.
sentences.zh: 这些新的威胁似乎旨在促使各国在此之前达成协议。

sentences.en: But so far, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，美国

sentences.en: has reached only two preliminary trade deals, with Britain and Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 仅与英国和越南达成了两项初步贸易协议。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Mary Wilson, Claire Tennesketter, and Olivia Natt.

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
